messages:
Avery: deploy-bot flagged staging promo as BLOCKED due to e2e failures on last canary run. looks like a test harness / grid timeout spike.

ci-bot: PROMO_BLOCK staging canary v2026.4.01 -> v2026.4.02
checks: e2e-suite: 14/20 passed
failures: browser-login.spec.js x3 (selenium grid timeout), checkout-flow.spec.js x2 (element not found), asset-upload.spec.js x1 (partial upload 206)
build logs: https://ci.internal/4412346789/canary/9

Lee: hmm. asset-upload partial 206 is worrying. that's the same area we fixed last week. could be unrelated but worth verifying artifact integrity on the image. anyone seen upload traces?

Pat: checking artifact registry. push for v2026.4.02 succeeded with manifest and all layers. but the deploy job shows a retry on blob chunk 4 and a 206. looks like transient S3 499s during multipart finalize.

qa-bot: FLAKE_METRICS: e2e-suite overall flake rate (7d): 6%. browser-login flake rate (24h): 18% correlated with selenium-grid worker restarts. asset-upload failures: 1 in 120 runs.

Avery: change window closes in 1h. product is expecting this cut. options: A) revert the feature PR that touched upload flow (revert commit 6f9a) and re-run; B) pin promo to previous image v2026.4.01; C) delay cut until we investigate. Thoughts?

Lee: if selenium grid instability is the biggest signal, reverting upload PR won't help browser-login flakes. but it might remove the 206 partial blob if that PR changed retry logic. Do we have confidence revert is safe?

Pat: revert is small (one file change to uploader retry headers). Low risk. But requires a new image build and another full canary run which could exceed the window. Pinning is fastest.

Avery: product says they can accept postponing Feature Y but prefer not to postpone the release. I lean pin + post-release hotfix. That matches previous cadence.

Lee: downside of pin is we ship without the bugfix in uploader. If 206 was transient, pin would be fine. If 206 is regresssion from other unrelated infra, we'd be shipping a non-fix. But timeboxed risk seems acceptable.

ci-bot: INFRA_HEALTH: selenium-grid pool reported 3 worker restarts in last 2h. S3 region us-east-1 reported increased 5xx rate between 10:02-10:10 UTC.

Avery: consensus: pin to v2026.4.01 to meet cut. We'll open a blocker ticket to revert the decision if canary rerun later shows persistent failures. Pat, can you open the pin PR and add release note metadata?

Pat: creating promo-pin PR now at https://git.internal/repo/promo-pin/789. I'll add a note: "Pin canary to v2026.4.01 due to transient infra-related e2e failures; feature Y will be included in next patch. Contact: @Avery"

Lee: also opening infra ticket to remediate selenium grid worker restarts and check S3 regional telemetry: https://infra.internal/tickets/1423. tagging @oncall.

deploy-bot: ACTION: promo pinned to v2026.4.01 (manual override) by Pat at 4412346920. Release window preserved.

Avery: thanks everyone. follow-ups: Pat to kick manual promote, Lee to own infra ticket, QA to re-run e2e after grid stabilization and verify asset-upload. We'll schedule a hotfix build with uploader revert if tests repro. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
